description.narrative: (West Bank and Gaza): The activity will create a path for vulnerable populations in Gaza to become more resilient and self-reliant by providing basic commodities and increasing employment opportunities. USAID also builds the capacity of local organizations to respond rapidly and effectively in the event of a crisis..Using FY 2021 funds, USAID will continue to provide assistance which includes cash for work opportunities, cash for internship, cash for apprenticeship programs, and entrepreneurship training. Interventions also include start up grants, and support to existing small businesses through small capital grants. The assistance may also include food and non-food vouchers assistance, in coordination with other activities providing similar aid. The activity will provide equal opportunities to men and women with a focus on youth and recent graduates...
